story.text: Files the vendor's benchmark: 38 ms at p95.
Computes the speed-up from the vendor's figure: 3.1 times.
Works out the servers: 8 of 12 carry the load, so 4 can go.
Load-tests Quarry on the team's own corpus: 44 ms at p95.
Claims Quarry is inside the target on the team's own corpus.
Decides: move to Quarry, retire 4 servers.
The vendor withdraws the benchmark: the cache was warm. Everything computed from it is now AT RISK — both results, both claims and the decision. The load-test claim stands.
Measures the current engine the same way: 123 ms, so Quarry is 2.8 times faster, not 3.1.
Revises both claims from the team's own measurement: 2.8 times faster, 9 servers needed. The decision is now flagged REVISIT: two of the claims it was based on changed.
Re-decides on the team's own numbers: retire 3 servers, not 4. The old decision is superseded.
